# IMPERIA COLD WAR — United Kingdom 1970 1974 politics effects.
# COLDWAR | Generated by tools/uk_1970/chapter_politics.py.

# Preferences belong to each party, including while it is in opposition.
# They are not proof that their holder is Prime Minister.
IMP_ENG_1974_seed_leadership = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader } }
        set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 1 }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "James Callaghan" ruling_only = yes } }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 2 }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Michael Foot" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Neil Kinnock" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "John Smith" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 5 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Tony Blair" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 6 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Margaret Beckett" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 7 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Tony Benn" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 8 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Denis Healey" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 9 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Barbara Castle" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 10 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Roy Hattersley" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 11 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "John Prescott" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 12 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Gordon Brown" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 13 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Peter Shore" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 14 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader } }
        set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 1 }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Margaret Thatcher" ruling_only = yes } }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 2 }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "John Major" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "William Hague" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 4 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Enoch Powell" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 8 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Douglas Hurd" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 7 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "William Whitelaw" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 6 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Kenneth Clarke" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 5 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Michael Heseltine" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 9 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Lord Carrington" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 10 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Francis Pym" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 11 } }
        if = { limit = { has_country_leader = { name = "Norman Tebbit" ruling_only = yes } } set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 12 } }
    }
}

# Called only from the country's existing set_leader_ENG dispatcher, after
# MD's set_leader has performed its normal outlook/party synchronization.
IMP_ENG_1974_set_coldwar_leader = {
    IMP_ENG_1974_seed_leadership = yes
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 2 } }
            create_country_leader = {
                name = "James Callaghan"
                picture = "gfx/leaders/ENG/COLDWAR_ENG_callaghan.dds"
                ideology = socialism
                expire = "2000.1.1"
                traits = { western_socialism career_politician }
            }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 3 } }
            create_country_leader = { name = "Michael Foot" picture = "gfx/leaders/ENG/COLDWAR_ENG_foot.dds" ideology = socialism expire = "2000.1.1" traits = { western_socialism career_politician } }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 4 } }
            create_country_leader = { name = "Neil Kinnock" picture = "gfx/leaders/ENG/ENG_COLDWAR_Neil_Kinnock.dds" ideology = socialism expire = "2000.1.1" traits = { western_socialism career_politician } }

# These flags are descriptive mirrors only. Focus/programme authority is the
# actual-PM scripted trigger above, so a preference or stale flag cannot unlock it.
IMP_ENG_1974_refresh_actual_office = {
    set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 0 }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_wilson_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_wilson_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_wilson_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_wilson_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_wilson_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_wilson_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_callaghan_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_callaghan_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_callaghan_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_callaghan_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_callaghan_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_callaghan_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_foot_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_foot_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_foot_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_foot_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_foot_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_foot_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_kinnock_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_kinnock_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_kinnock_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_kinnock_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_kinnock_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_kinnock_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_smith_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_smith_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_smith_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_smith_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_smith_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_smith_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_heath_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_heath_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_heath_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_heath_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_heath_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_heath_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_thatcher_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_thatcher_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_thatcher_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_thatcher_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_thatcher_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_thatcher_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { IMP_ENG_1974_major_in_office = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_major_actual_pm } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_major_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { IMP_ENG_1974_major_in_office = yes } has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_major_actual_pm }
        clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_major_actual_pm
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_office_changed = 1 } }
        COLDWAR_ENG_POLISH_refresh = yes
        mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
    }
}

# Native on_new_term_election opens MD4_election_campaign.0. Its accepted
# popup schedules MD4_election.0 after fourteen days (MD_Elections.txt:1292).
# The anchors are campaign opening days, fourteen days before the polling dates.
# Normal immediate acceptance therefore produces the approved polling dates.
# Delaying a native popup can delay the result; this code never picks a winner.
IMP_ENG_1974_arm_native_election_timer = {
    if = { limit = { has_elections = yes }
        set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1980s_owned_leader_guard = 0 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = no_leader_change } }
            set_country_flag = no_leader_change
            set_temp_variable = { IMP_ENG_1980s_owned_leader_guard = 1 }
        }
        if = { limit = { date < 1970.6.4 }
            set_politics = { ruling_party = THIS last_election = "1965.6.4" election_frequency = 60 elections_allowed = yes }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 0 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { date < 1974.9.26 }
            set_politics = { ruling_party = THIS last_election = "1969.9.26" election_frequency = 60 elections_allowed = yes }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 1 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { date < 1979.4.19 }
            set_politics = { ruling_party = THIS last_election = "1974.4.19" election_frequency = 60 elections_allowed = yes }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 2 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { date < 1983.5.26 }
            set_politics = { ruling_party = THIS last_election = "1978.5.26" election_frequency = 60 elections_allowed = yes }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 3 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { date < 1987.5.28 }
            set_politics = { ruling_party = THIS last_election = "1982.5.28" election_frequency = 60 elections_allowed = yes }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 4 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { date < 1992.3.26 }
            set_politics = { ruling_party = THIS last_election = "1987.3.26" election_frequency = 60 elections_allowed = yes }
            set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 5 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_election_calendar_phase = 6 } }
        if = { limit = { check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1980s_owned_leader_guard = 1 } } clr_country_flag = no_leader_change }
    }
}

IMP_ENG_1974_offer_labour_succession = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_labour_review_pending } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_labour_review_pending
        country_event = { id = IMP_ENG_1974_politics.1 days = 1 }
    }
}

IMP_ENG_1974_offer_conservative_review = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_review_pending } }
        set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_review_pending
        country_event = { id = IMP_ENG_1974_politics.2 days = 1 }
    }
}

IMP_ENG_1974_politics_daily = {
    if = { limit = { original_tag = ENG IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes date < 2000.1.1 }
        IMP_ENG_1974_seed_leadership = yes
        IMP_ENG_1974_refresh_actual_office = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1980s_election_calendar_migrated } has_elections = yes IMP_ENG_1974_native_government_settled = yes }
            set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1980s_election_calendar_migrated
            IMP_ENG_1974_arm_native_election_timer = yes
        }
        if = { limit = { has_country_flag = elections_in_progress }
            set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_native_campaign_seen
        }
        if = { limit = {
                has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_native_campaign_seen
                IMP_ENG_1974_native_government_settled = yes
            }
            clr_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_native_campaign_seen
            # Reapply after the resolver/coalition has settled, in case the
            # engine reset its last-election date during the native chain.
            IMP_ENG_1974_arm_native_election_timer = yes
        }
        if = { limit = {
                date > 1975.2.10
                date < 1976.1.1
                NOT = { check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 } }
                check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_conservative_leader = 1 }
                NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_opposition_ballot_offered }
                IMP_ENG_1974_native_government_settled = yes
            }
            set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_opposition_ballot_offered
            # Leadership changes are chosen in the party leadership decisions.
        }
        if = { limit = {
                date > 1976.4.4
                check_variable = { IMP_ENG_1974_labour_leader = 1 }
                NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_labour_retirement_offered }
                IMP_ENG_1974_native_government_settled = yes
            }
            set_country_flag = IMP_ENG_1974_labour_retirement_offered
            # Leadership changes are chosen in the party leadership decisions.
        }
    }
}
